opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The main applicant must have BES membership. Groups of 8-15 participants with a diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by funding the formation of new two-year synthesis groups that bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups to focus on data analysis and synthesis.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: up to £500 per year for a decade of data collection; first five years' funding (£3,500) claimable in year 1, with an additional £3,500 in year 6.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners, reserve managers and consultants, as well as university academics. Awards are to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides a small amount of funding each year for 10 years to enable existing short-term projects with 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term, supporting long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level, in formal or informal educational settings. Awards are to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funds research informing teaching and learning practices in ecology, providing up to £5k towards evidence-based learning, improving learners' experience and promoting excellence in teaching.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants

amount.raw: Grant awards of up to £20,000 can be claimed from the applicant.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations. Undergraduates and masters students are not eligible. Awards are to individuals.
opportunities.summary: Funds interdisciplinary secondments of up to 12 months, immersing ecologists in a different discipline or sector (e.g. NGO, public sector, business) to build interdisciplinary skills.

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Member-only grant; researchers from all countries globally, projects can be conducted anywhere in the world. Two reference statements, one personal statement and one supporting letter required.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: The lead applicant must have BES membership. Open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels. Projects must be aimed at a non-academic audience.
opportunities.summary: Supports BES members to deliver independent outreach, public engagement and science communication activities engaging public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 is available to cover registration fees for virtual conferences/courses; a maximum of £500 is available for events in person.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher (PGRs registered on a postgraduate research degree programme). Postdocs, undergraduates and masters students are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in a Global South country; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; must be at least three years since last awarded a BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting 2026 in the UK, covering travel, registration, food and accommodation costs.
